bullets.title: STX: Massive Beat-and-Raise on AI Data Center Demand; Citi Buy, $1,240 PT
bullets.body: Seagate Q4 revenue $3.63B (+48% YoY, beat $3.50B est), EPS $5.71 (+121% YoY, beat $5.10 est), gross margin 52.7% (+1,480 bps YoY). ~90% of capacity shipped to data center customers. Q1 guidance of $4.1B revenue and $7.30 EPS demolished Street's $3.78B/$5.85. Stock +7.3% AH. Citi maintains Buy at $1,240 PT (66% total return) citing durable pricing and margin expansion on AI/cloud demand.

bullets.title: KLAC: Q4 Beat, Q1 Guide Above Consensus; AI Infrastructure Momentum Accelerating
bullets.body: KLA Q4 EPS $1.05 vs $1.00 est, revenue $3.66B vs $3.61B est; Q1 guided to $4.0B revenue and $1.16 EPS vs Street $3.93B/$1.14. Foundry/logic jumped to 79% of semi process control revenue (from 62% in Q3). JPM notes KLAC CEO says momentum accelerating in H2 2026 and through 2027, with PCB/Display & Component inspection reaching 7% of revenue; WFE outlook raised to $150B (25% growth implied).

bullets.title: NXPI: Q2 Beat Across All End Markets; SDV and Physical AI Driving Multi-Year Growth
bullets.body: NXP Q2 revenue $3.50B (+19% YoY, beat $3.47B est), EPS $3.61 beat $3.52; growth across all regions and end markets. Physical AI design-win pipeline >$1.5B spanning 200+ customers; SDV revenue to double from €1B in 2024 to €2B by 2027; data center revenue tracking to >$500M in 2026. Q3 guided $3.65–3.85B revenue, EPS $3.89–4.32. Lead times extended with backlog visibility into Q1 2027.

bullets.title: GLW: Q2 Beat on Optical/Solar; Reaffirms 19% Revenue CAGR to $30B by 2028; Stock -12% on Q3 Guide Optics
bullets.body: Corning Q2 revenue $4.74B (+17% YoY) beat guidance of $4.6B; EPS $0.78 (+30% YoY) beat consensus $0.76. Q3 sales guided $4.9–5.0B slightly below Street $5.0B; EPS guided $0.85–0.95 vs Street $0.85. Management reaffirmed Springboard targets: $20B revenue run-rate by end-2026, $30B by end-2028 with ~19% CAGR. Stock -12.1% on optical division softness and mixed Q3 guidance despite Citi maintaining Buy at $220 PT.

bullets.title: CLS: +10% on Q2 Beat-and-Raise; AI Infrastructure Cycle Broadening Across Accelerator Generations
bullets.body: Celestica Q2 results beat and raised guidance; street-wide commentary cites 65% revenue growth expected in 2027. Consigned AI racks boost margin quality but create near-term reported revenue comparison distortions. CEO commentary confirmed AI infrastructure cycle is broadening and extending beyond a single accelerator or networking generation.

bullets.title: RCL: Strong Q2 Beat; FY26 EPS Raised $0.50; 2027 Yield Debate the Key Overhang
bullets.body: RCL Q2 adj EPS $4.21 beat guidance $3.83–3.93; FY26 EPS guidance raised $0.50 to $17.73–17.87. Citi raises PT to $362, Mizuho Outperform at $380. Bull case: 2027 bookings at record levels, private island tailwinds. Bear case: UBS and Citi note Q4 200 bps drydock tailwind means exit rate closer to +3% yield growth vs Street's +4% consensus for 2027.

bullets.title: AAPL: Hits $5T Market Cap; Launches 'Apple Upgrade' Leasing Program via Klarna
bullets.body: Apple briefly exceeded $5T market cap, becoming only the second company after NVDA to achieve the milestone. Separately, Apple launched 'Apple Upgrade,' a new device leasing program via Klarna with iPhones from $17.99/month, MacBook Air from $24.99/month, and bundles from $61/month. Analysts note the program removes need for price cuts to drive ecosystem adoption and makes competing PC ecosystems less cost-competitive. Q3 earnings report due 7/30; consensus expects $109B revenue (+16% YoY) and $1.89 EPS.

bullets.title: NVDA: Taipei Office Raided in Chip-Smuggling Probe; CEO Meets Commerce Secretary; Moonshot Seeking More Blackwells
bullets.body: Taiwan authorities raided Nvidia's Taipei office as part of an AI chip-smuggling investigation with arrests made. CEO Jensen Huang met with Commerce Secretary Lutnick amid China export scrutiny. Separately, Chinese AI startup Moonshot is seeking additional Blackwell GPUs for its Kimi K4 model, signaling continued enterprise demand. UBS estimates NVDA will generate ~$900B FCF through CYE2028, supporting the semis thesis despite circular financing concerns.

bullets.title: AMD: Down 10% on Semis Rout; CORZ Infrastructure Partnership 2.5GW; Neocloud Engagement Expanding
bullets.body: AMD fell ~10% intraday as part of the broader semiconductor selloff. AMD signed a partnership with CORZ for up to 2.5GW of data center capacity starting with 500MW in 2027. Management discussed expanding neocloud engagement with 152MW available for lease; already entrenched with HotAisle and Tensorwave. CEO Lisa Su noted AI is at an inflection point with growing useful work applications.

bullets.title: MU: Analyst Projects $254B NTM Revenue, 44% of Market Cap in Earnings Over 8 Quarters
bullets.body: One analyst estimates Micron will generate $254B in revenue in the next four unreported quarters and $310B in the following four, representing 44% of its ~$920B market cap at $810/share. Separately, HF prime data showed memory names saw the largest 2-day net selling since the trade gained popularity, with MU large put positions accumulated by institutional traders.

bullets.title: DELL: -14.8%, Largest Single-Day Decline Since April on Broader AI Selloff
bullets.body: Dell fell 14.8% in its worst single-session decline since April 2025 as the broader AI and momentum trade continued to unwind. No company-specific negative catalyst; decline attributed to sector deleveraging, circular financing concerns, and capex skepticism among hyperscalers.

bullets.title: META: $14B El Paso Data Center Venture with BlackRock; Earnings Wednesday
bullets.body: Meta and BlackRock announced a $14B joint venture for a data center in El Paso focused on AI infrastructure. META reports Q2 earnings Wednesday; GS notes Mag 7 positioning is near 1-year lows (3rd percentile) ahead of results. Large put positions were also noted being accumulated on META.

bullets.title: T (AT&T): Closes $23B EchoStar Spectrum Acquisition; Reaffirms FY26 and 2028 Outlook
bullets.body: AT&T completed the acquisition of ~50 MHz of low/mid-band spectrum from EchoStar covering virtually every US market; reiterates FY26 EPS guidance $2.25–2.35, FCF $18B+, and plans $45B+ shareholder returns 2026–2028. AT&T expects net debt/EBITDA to return to ~2.5x target within ~3 years. Q2 EPS $0.65 beat $0.59 consensus. Stock +21.6% since July 1 after -30% Q2 decline.

bullets.title: OMC: Q2 Organic Growth +6.1%, Well Above Street; Citi Buy at $105
bullets.body: Omnicom Q2 organic revenue +6.1% vs Street +3.6% est; core revenue $6.0B (+7% YoY). Adjusted EBITA $1.13B slightly missed Street $1.16B. FY26 organic growth guided 5% with high-teens EPS growth; $900M synergy target on track with 75–80% impacting EBITDA margin in 2026. $5B buyback with $3B executed by July. Citi maintains Buy at $105 (22% upside). Clients consolidating more work with OMC.

bullets.title: CVLT: Mixed F1Q27 — SaaS ARR +38% YoY Strong, But NNARR Growth Disappointing; Mizuho Outperform $175, Wolfe Peer Perform
bullets.body: Commvault Subscription ARR grew 22% YoY to $1.05B in-line; SaaS ARR +38% to $424M beat Street. However, net new subscription ARR of ~$40M moderated on FX, supply chain, and softer conversion; sub NNARR ex-Identity was again negative. EBIT margins beat at 22.8% vs 19% guidance. Mizuho reiterates Outperform, PT $175 (5.8x CY27 EV/ARR); Wolfe maintains Peer Perform citing growth headwinds. Stock -18% on earnings day.

bullets.title: CRWV: JPM Neutral; PT $105 Unchanged After Model Update for Revenue/Capex Linearity
bullets.body: JPMorgan updated its CRWV model for revenue and capex timing linearity reflecting capacity coming online in 2H26; price target remains $105 (vs $67.30 current price). Rating unchanged at Neutral.

bullets.title: LITE/COHR/GLW/FN: Photonics Physical Buildout Ongoing; Near-Term Estimate Risk Flagged; InP Supply a Chokepoint
bullets.body: One analyst covering the photonics sector for ~9 months notes the physical buildout remains underway despite recent sentiment deterioration. Separately, a research note flagged material near-term estimate risk across AVGO, MRVL, COHR, LITE, and FN on photonics. Lumentum CEO specifically flagged InP (indium phosphide) as a supply chokepoint with implications across lasers, optical engines, and AI infrastructure.

bullets.title: AMZN: Multiple PT Cuts Ahead of Earnings Thursday; UBS to $305, Mizuho to $320, BMO to $360
bullets.body: UBS cut Amazon PT to $305 from $333 (most aggressive cut) while Mizuho trimmed to $320 from $325 and BMO raised to $360 from $355 — reflecting divergent views ahead of Thursday earnings. Amazon's AI shopping assistant usage more than doubled in 2025 with 50%+ of shoppers open to full AI-driven purchases. Amazon also secured a 12-year NHL streaming rights deal in Canada via Prime Video.

bullets.title: Semis Momentum Selloff: SOX -25% from Highs; HF De-grossing Largest Since Sept 2025
bullets.body: SOX ETF in 25.7% drawdown from highs with four consecutive sessions of weakness. Goldman's high-beta momentum basket tracking toward worst monthly performance in history (worse than 2000, 2009). All three HF strategy types (Fundamental L/S -1.3%, Systematic L/S -1.0%, Multi-Strats -1.7%) down >1% on 7/28 simultaneously for first time since COVID. Memory names saw largest 2-day net selling since the trade gained popularity; Global IT stocks saw largest long selling since Jan 2021. JPM TMT desk cites weak earnings prints, circular financing concerns, and CSP capex cut anxiety.

bullets.title: INTC: Completes DoD RAMP-C Program; Unusual $8.8M OTM Call Print
bullets.body: Intel Foundry completed the DoD RAMP-C program for secure domestic leading-edge semiconductor manufacturing (launched Oct 2021, three-phase program). Separately, an unusual $8.8M out-of-the-money call option print was noted on INTC, suggesting large directional bullish positioning.
